About this desk. "Ithu Ungal Soththu" — this is YOUR property. Chennai's buses, metros, suburban trains and the agencies that run them are public assets. UngalSoththu tracks their operations, plans, budgets and the accountability gaps in between: service changes, fares, fleet, ridership, project progress, audits — number-led, source-linked, never party-political.
Published by the UngalSoththu desk of CashlessConsumer. Sources: linked news reports and agency replies; figures are as reported by the cited publication on the cited date.
